name: ghostdodo
description: GhostDodo — 지원하기 전에, 답은 해주는 회사인지 확인하세요.

scripts.services:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v && pnpm services:up
scripts.api:dev: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.api:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.api:seed: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.scripts.seed
scripts.api:lint: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check app tests && uv run mypy app
